Added missing LoginFormComponent translations to login route
Added Prisma migrations script for prod and dev database deploys, in preparation for when we switch over to managed databases.
Created a Nav menu component that lists a navigation menu, and created the route for the menu manager
Extended Plop generator to allow the selection of tags and categories
Created base component for the MenuEditor
We now have a very rudimentary draggable menu editor interface
MenuEditor now works as component that can be previewed.
We now have a basic workflow for editing the menu
Swapped navigation menu out for the actual header (in demo mode), which also meant we can load the dynamic header on the site itself. Also swapped orientation on the manage menu page
Extracted save action and implemented it on the page level, just like Cancel.
Semantically fixed db migrations workflow
Smaller changes and improvements so that we can work with illustrations in Puck
Event model is amended with organiser and image fields which are seeded and shown in UI.
Added box and line illustrations, and created the hand drawn box component
